Hi Jennifer — great to hear from you and welcome onboard. Short answers first, then an ops checklist below.

- Preferred: our Supplier Portal (fastest, provides auto-acknowledgement and PO matching).
- Email: acceptable as a fallback but requires specific subject tokens and a PDF or XLSX attachment.
- Required data: Redwood PO number in header or first line, vendor name, remit address, line-level qty/unit/price, and tax ID on the invoice.

I'll include an ops checklist and a sample template. If you prefer email fallback, please use subject: "Invoice: PO <REDACTED-PO-NUM> | Acme Corp" and send to invoices@redwood.ai.

Attachment: sample_invoice_template.xlsx (XLSX)

Ops checklist (high level):
1) Portal: create vendor account -> upload W9/KB docs -> map default remit -> sync PO config. Portal gives instant ACK and status dashboards.
2) Email fallback: subject token required -> single PDF/XLSX attached -> PO number visible in subject or first page -> NO zips.
3) For non-PO invoices (one-off charges), include vendor contact + GL coding in body.
4) If you expect large monthly batched files, we recommend SFTP onboarding (we can share specs).

Marissa and Karthik, tagging you so procurement/ops FYI — can we confirm cutoff SLA for invoices submitted via email before we accept the fallback? Jennifer — happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez\Senior Sales Operations\Redwood Inference

On Thu, Apr 22, 2026 at 11:20 AM Jennifer Simmons <billing@acme.com> wrote:
> 1) For the subject token, will your system still ingest if the PO is in the first page of the PDF but not in the subject?
> 2) Our invoices are generated by Coupa and sometimes include multiple attachments per transaction.

Short answers for production ops:
- We prefer PO in the subject for deterministic routing. If PO is only inside the PDF we can still attempt OCR and KV-extract, but that moves the invoice to a manual queue on mismatch and may add 24-72hr processing time.
- Multiple attachments: our ingestion pipeline supports a single invoice attachment + supplementary docs. If Coupa emits multiple PDFs, ask them to combine into a single PDF or label the primary invoice file as "invoice.pdf" in the email. Zipped files are a hard fail.

Operational limits: invoices@redwood.ai inbox is policed by automated routing. Email fallback is permitted for low-volume vendors (<= 10 invoices/month). For any vendor exceeding that, procurement will require portal or SFTP.

Marissa — can you confirm the threshold step-in for when the vendor needs to be forced into portal onboarding? Also, we should update the vendor_onboarding_form_v3.pdf to include a recommended subject line field.

Thanks,
Karthik\Head of Procurement Operations\Redwood Inference
